data.narrative:
Kinetic Automation is a Series B robotics and manufacturing automation company that has raised approximately $31M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four same-sector, same or adjacent-stage companies: Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B, Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B, Series C). This represents a subset of a broader 9-company private comp universe in robotics and manufacturing automation, alongside one public comparable.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given data availability. The median valuation across the four selected peers is $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $1.8B. This peer-median approach reflects valuations for robotics companies at or near Kinetic's stage, capturing recent market pricing for similar risk and growth profiles.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $1.9B (high), centered on a median of $1.6B. Key uncertainties include the degree to which Kinetic's specific technology, unit economics, and market traction align with the selected peers, as well as market conditions and momentum in the broader robotics sector. The narrow methodological base (one applicable method) suggests additional valuation approaches would strengthen conviction if data becomes available.
